BHA Edge: Control Over Chaos Secures the Win

BHA edged out Leeds United 2-1, largely by controlling the tempo through superior intensity. The analysis showed BHA’s pressing was highly effective, with a low PPDA of 5.8, meaning they pressed much harder than the opponent’s 9.7. BHA maintained possession at 47% against Leeds United’s 52.9%.

The game plan held up well, particularly in counter-press regains at 27%, although the defensive line height drifted below target at times. The match-turning moment came via a set piece in the 63rd minute, where #5 Isaac Kane-Moss scored a header, securing the vital second goal. Earlier, BHA capitalized on sustained pressure, scoring #9 Harvey Radley in the 19th minute following a high regain.
